metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for building Anumat: design research and evidence, and the Bun + Turborepo monorepo stack the Anumat repos use.

plugins.name: design-stack
plugins.description: Design research and evidence layer for UI work: canonical screen playbooks, design-system selection, and a hard gate on interface states.

plugins.name: monorepo-stack
plugins.description: Scaffold and maintain a Bun + Turborepo monorepo: several apps, shared packages, and Storybook as a first-class layer, with the conventions to extend it correctly.
